test.result: 16 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Capacity is the lower of ADV participation and visible depth, then multiplied by an explicit safety factor. Missing, stale, future or over-cap evidence yields NO_TRADE.

implemented: Capacity requires positive finite ADV, visible depth, participation cap and an explicit safety factor in (0,1].
Order-capacity verdict requires a nonempty evidence ID and timezone-aware observed and decision timestamps within a maximum age.
Orders above conservative capacity are withheld with a deterministic reason rather than clipped into a new order.
blockers: The capacity gate is not yet wired into every target portfolio and paper order adapter.
ADV derivation/source provenance and visible-depth semantics are caller-supplied, not independently validated here.
The 20% haircut is a configurable safety input, not empirically calibrated; no forward fill/capacity claim is made.
scope_note: A fail-closed observed-liquidity contract is implemented and tested, but universal runner enforcement and source freshness policy remain incomplete.
